messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: sudden increase in DNS NODATA/NXDOMAIN from a subset of EU and LATAM clients. Metric: client_resolve_failures +28% over 15m. Auto-severity P2. Posting to #incidents.

maya_sre: spotted weird split behavior: some resolvers getting valid A answers for api.redwood-inference.com, others returning NODATA. Affected path seems to correlate with specific ISP ASNs (AS12345, AS67890).

tom_net: running targeted dig from two vantage pts (eu-west /sao-paulo):
```
# eu-west (good) -> Route53 answer
dig @8.8.8.8 api.redwood-inference.com +short
10.2.3.4

# sao-paulo (bad) -> Cloudflare resolvers returning NODATA
dig @1.1.1.1 api.redwood-inference.com +short
<no output>
```

jess_support: Customer Impact: two customers (ShopLite EU, MediaCorp BR) reported intermittent 502s when fetching models. ShopLite reports 10-15% failed requests, MediaCorp higher during morning traffic. Tickets 11022, 11023.

maya_sre: logs show DNSSEC validation failures in some resolver stacks (RRSIG validation). Cloudflare-side frontends appear to drop the record when DNSSEC validation fails for that resolver path, while Route53 still serves. Need to confirm with Cloudflare but this could be a validation/EDNS0 path MTU issue.

rafi_dev: hypothesis: EDNS0 blocksize causing fragmented UDP responses and validation failures on certain middleboxes/ISPs. Could explain per-ISP behavior.

ops-oncall: taking pager. Plan: 1) quickly bias geo-DNS to prefer Route53 for the problematic delegations for EU+LATAM 2) spin up higher probe density for affected ASNs 3) notify customers. Handoff accepted.

incident-bot: ops-oncall claimed the incident at 1789991299.

tom_net: applying a conservative bias for affected regions now (5% to start) using infra-dns CLI. Command:
```
infra-dns set-bias --record api.redwood-inference.com --region eu,latam --to route53 --weight 5
```

maya_sre: started per-ISP probes to validate. Early canary: the 5% subset routed to Route53 drops failures from 28% -> 6% for those clients. Good signal.

jess_support: letting ShopLite & MediaCorp know we started mitigation and ETA for wider roll is ~20m. Asked them to disable aggressive client retries for now.

ops-oncall: increasing bias to 40% at 1789991400 after 8m stable. Watching for cache churn and unexpected latency regressions.

rafi_dev: note: Route53 answers slightly higher latency (p95 +80ms) but success rate is far better. Logging potential cost delta.

tom_net: evidence captured: pcap shows DNS responses with EDNS0 UDP size 4096 from authoritative that cause fragmentation; some ISPs' middleboxes drop fragments leading to validation errors. Will attach pcaps.

incident-bot: mitigation update logged at 1789991475: bias increased to 40%. Probes set to 3s interval for affected ASNs.

maya_sre: after 12m of 40% bias, aggregate failures dropped from 28% -> 4% across impacted ASNs. Recommend roll to 100% for eu+latam for this record while Cloudflare investigates.

ops-oncall: rolling to 100% bias at 1789991520. Added short-term monitor to mute alerts for transient negative cache effects for 10m.

jess_support: customers reporting restoration. Closing immediate high-priority tickets, leaving RCA timeline.

leo_pm: please capture user-visible downtime per tenant and latency impact. Also log mitigation cost estimate. We'll review in postmortem.

rafi_dev: follow-ups for engineering: 1) add an EDNS0/fragmentation detector to DNS probe suite 2) test provider failover automation in staging 3) include per-ASN health in geo-routing decisions.

maya_sre: contacted Cloudflare support with evidence (pcaps + resolver behavior). They acknowledged and are investigating potential middlebox/DNSSEC validation interactions on certain frontends.

ops-oncall: leaving handoff notes for next oncall: bias remains at 100% for api.redwood-inference.com eu+latam delegation; probes continue. Runbook updated with play: reduce EDNS0 payload size on authoritative answers as alternative mitigation if providers can't fix.

incident-bot: MITIGATION: geo-bias to Route53 applied for affected regions. Incident set to under mitigation at 1789991700. Please open RCA in #postmortems and attach logs/pcaps.
